test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

_ c b _ _ a m c c _ e a a _ c c _ e _ _ m

options.text: c e a b m b e a
c a e b m b e a
c a a b m b a a
c e a b m b a a

solution:
Given series: _ c b _ _ a m c c _ e a a _ c c _ e _ _ m 

Option 1) c e a b m b e a → __c__ c b __e__ __a__ a m c c __b__ e a a __m__ c c __b__ e __e__ __a__ m → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) c a e b m b e a → __c__ c b __a__ __e__ a m c c __b__ e a a __m__ c c __b__ e __e__ __a__ m → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) c a a b m b a a → __c__ c b __a__ __a__ a m c c __b__ e a a __m__ c c __b__ e __a__ __a__ m → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) c e a b m b a a → __**c**__ c b __**e**__ __**a**__ a m c c __**b**__ e a a __**m**__ c c __**b**__ e __**a**__ __**a**__ m → (It follows the pattern of: ccbeaam - ccbeaam - ccbeaam - ccbeaam)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
